checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The includesText names arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only the basic services fee as overhead; no second mandatory facilities or staff fee text appears.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered, but no text says a casket is required for it; purchaser-provided container and alternative containers are listed.
The direct cremation description includes cremation, and no crematory cash-advance charge is listed to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines, and no other offered service lacks its own line.
The list contains only required single-price items and separate goods and services, with no optional package combination.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase; the required non-requirement wordings are not such claims.
No text claims delay of decomposition or protection from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no disclosure is shown as hard to notice.
